scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @9l/playwright && npm run build --workspace @9l/browser-checks
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/playwright/test/*.test.cjs packages/browser-checks/test/*.test.cjs internal/assessment/analyzer.test.cjs scripts/bundle-assessment-parser.test.cjs scripts/sdk-registry.test.cjs scripts/release-version.test.cjs

scripts.demo: npm run build && go run ./cmd/9l run testdata/sdk/tests/checkout.spec.ts --sdk --format json
